# The most bytes a chat reply may be on the wire (the text as the chat's JSON writes it): a chat is a message with
# no subject whose text is the JSON of the chat, and a message's text may be kMaxLetterText (261000, what an object of
# 2^18 bytes holds less its header, keys, acknowledgment, signature and encryption) less the 115 bytes of "Subject:",
# "\nBody:" and the JSON around the body, with the longest sequence number. Both sides check themselves against this file:
# bmc::chatFits (tests/bmclient/chat_format_test.cpp) and btc.MaxChatReply (internal/btc of the btcbot repository, which keeps a copy of this file).
260885
